description: Pinned reference outputs for the DEFINE-UK validation gate. Single source of truth for every number the test suite compares the cached pinned upstream run against. All values were recorded from real repo artifacts (the cached run of the pinned commit, Manual v1.1 Table 4, and validation/baseline_vs_external.csv); none are invented. Update only deliberately, with a VALIDATION.md run-record entry.

table4_baseline.source: DEFINE-UK Model Manual v1.1, Table 4 (p.50); replication recorded VALIDATION.md target 1a, 2026-08-04

real_gdp_growth_pct.note: no single growth convention reproduces all three years (2030 matches annual-mean y/y exactly, 2040 is 0.06pp off it and matches the mean of 4x quarterly growth instead, 2025 matches neither); 2025 sits in the post-2022 start-up transient (quarterly y/y 6.2, 5.1, 4.1, 3.3 within 2025); the band is the 2025 miss, unchanged since 2026-08-04

emissions_divergence.source: VALIDATION.md target 1b: pinned commit's baseline EMIS runs below Table 4, widening with horizon (consistent with a different vintage but not proven; not an extraction error); gated at the observed ratios so further drift fails loudly

pinned_scenario_deltas.source: Exact annual-mean scenario-minus-baseline deltas from the cached run at the pinned commit (CSV precision ~4 sig figs); recorded 2026-08-04 in tests/test_scenarios.py
pinned_scenario_deltas.convention: scenario minus baseline, annual mean of quarterly levels, calendar anchored 1987Q1-2040Q4

gpi_multiplier.source: define_uk.validation.gpi_multiplier() on the cached pinned run; recorded 2026-08-05 (VALIDATION.md); headline definition changed 2026-11-15 (issue #16, decided: option B); headline window changed 2026-11-18 from the full simulation to the policy window (the full-simulation figures are kept under full_simulation, unchanged); replaces the unusable upstream Multiplier_Summary.csv
gpi_multiplier.definition: cum dGDP / cum dSPEND_GVTPS (government power-sector spending, the policy instrument), nominal, from the policy start (2027Q1) to 2040Q4, GPI + Green Bonds vs baseline
gpi_multiplier.horizon_note: same ratio counted from the policy start (2027Q1) to the end of each year; recorded 2026-11-17 (Fable 5.2 results review)

secondary.definition: cum dGDP / cum dSPEND_GVT (total government spending excluding wages), nominal, from the policy start (2027Q1) to 2040Q4

full_simulation.note: the headline window until 2026-11-18: 2023Q1-2040Q4, which includes four years with no policy (their 4.8 of GDP delta is the alpha_PP mismatch, issue #20); values unchanged from the earlier record

secondary.definition: cum dGDP / cum dSPEND_GVT, nominal, full simulation; the headline until 2026-11-15

stock_flow_consistency.source: define_uk.scenarios.sfc_check on every Variables_*.csv of the cached pinned run; recorded 2026-11-06
stock_flow_consistency.redundant_equation: LEND = sum of sectoral net lending; zero in a consistent solve
stock_flow_consistency.sectoral_sum_note: sum of the seven LEND_* columns vs LEND over the simulation quarters; each column is printed to 4 significant figures; observed max 0.059 in consistent files

oracle_identity_residuals.source: tests/test_oracle.py: each registered equation evaluated on the oracle's own values for its inputs (state = quarter t, lag = t-1), simulation quarters 2023Q1-2040Q4; recorded 2026-11-06
oracle_identity_residuals.tolerance_note: every input is printed to 4 significant figures (relative error up to 5e-4 each); observed max 1.4e-3 (Eq. (134) NW_PS)
oracle_identity_residuals.printing_bound_note: since 2026-11-06 an equation reproduces if |model - oracle| <= max(tolerance_rel * |oracle|, first-order propagation of 5e-4 relative rounding of every input read plus the output); this moved GOS_PS, RP_PS and NW_PS to reproduced. 12 equations carry a pinned oracle form (tests/test_oracle.py ORACLE_FORMS); prop_NFF, CR_PS, DEF_PS remain divergent
